title: Horizon Hub | Keyless  & Open source
features:
# Horizon Hub | Bone Breaker Edition

A WindUI-based Roblox hub featuring automation, movement utilities, live statistics, configuration management, and customizable settings.

**Features**

**Auto Strike**
- Auto Strike
- Auto Farm Sync
- FAST, POWER & COMBO modes
- Adjustable Strike Power (10–200%)
- Hit Effects Toggle
- Adjustable Effect Size (1–10)
- Manual Single Hit
- Start / Stop Controls
- Reset Counters

**Statistics**
- Live Broken Bones Counter
- Hits Per Second Tracking
- Maximum Velocity Tracking
- Live Session Timer
- Copy Statistics
- Reset Statistics
- Broken Bones & Velocity Tracking Toggles

**Movement**
- Forward Dash
- Upward Boost
- Adjustable Dash Power
- Position Lock
- Stop Velocity
- Character Respawn

**Configuration**
- Save Configurations
- Load Configurations
- Delete Configurations
- Saved Config Selection
- Custom Config Names
- Reset Config Name to Default
- Save Settings

**Interface & Settings**
- Live FPS Counter
- Live Ping Display
- Player Profile Information
- RightShift Menu Toggle (Customizable)
- Notifications Toggle
- Auto Start Features Toggle
- Anti-AFK
- Close Hub Button
- Automatic Cleanup of Active Connections on Close
- Kick Call Suppression
- Midnight Theme
- Draggable Open Button
- Customizable Interface Effects

**Additional Details**
- Real-time strike automation
- Persistent configuration support through WindUI
- Session monitoring
- Customizable visual feedback
- Horizon Hub v1.2
